title: ClipForge Mobile (React PWA) — Frontend Implementation Plan

requirements.summary: Mobile-first app shell with persistent bottom tabs (Home/Templates/Create/Projects/Profile) plus dark/light mode.
acceptanceCriteria: App has a persistent bottom navigation with the 5 tabs and sensible routes/screens for each.
A theme toggle (or system-aware theme) switches between dark and light mode and applies consistently across screens.
UI is mobile-first and works at common phone widths without horizontal scrolling.

file_operations.description: Create the root app shell: bottom tab navigation with routes/screens for Home, Templates, Create, Projects, Profile; include a top-level layout container and route wiring so all screens are reachable.
Add global base styles for mobile-first layout (safe-area padding, prevent horizontal scroll), and enable Tailwind dark mode class support with consistent background/foreground tokens.
Adjust theme tokens (colors/radius/shadows) to support the app’s design system for both dark and light mode; ensure primary accent avoids blue/purple.
Implement theme state (system-aware default + user override), persist preference in localStorage, and apply/remove the Tailwind dark class at the document root.
Create a compact theme toggle UI for the app header/profile screen. Use shadcn-ui primitives where appropriate (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
Create the Home tab screen with quick actions (e.g., Start from Template, New Video, New Photo) and offline/config status indicators.
Create the Templates tab screen shell; actual catalog/content wired in REQ-4/REQ-7.
Create the Create tab screen with entry points into Video Editor and Photo Editor flows and template-based creation.
Create the Projects tab screen shell; list/search/sort/duplicate/delete wired in REQ-8.
Create the Profile tab screen with login/logout entry point (Internet Identity), user profile setup, theme toggle, and Pro/Free status display (wired in REQ-9).

requirements.summary: Define and apply a cohesive CapCut-inspired (non-branded) design system: typography, spacing, component styles, and motion guidelines; avoid blue/purple primary.
acceptanceCriteria: A documented design theme is applied across key screens (Home/Templates/Create/Projects/Profile + editor screens).
Primary color palette does not use blue/purple as the main accent.
Interactive elements (buttons, tabs, modals, sliders) share consistent styling and motion.

file_operations.description: Document the UI theme: typography scale, spacing, color palette (non-blue/purple primary), component styling rules, and motion/transition guidelines used across app and editors.
Define CSS variables for the design tokens (light/dark), base typography, and shared motion easing/duration utilities to apply consistently across screens.
Create a reusable scaffold (header/content/bottom-nav slots) that applies consistent spacing, typography, and transitions between routes.

Implement a consistent bottom navigation bar with tab icons/labels, active state styling, and subtle transitions. Use shadcn-ui building blocks where helpful (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
Create a consistent modal/sheet pattern for mobile (e.g., tool settings, export dialog). Use shadcn-ui dialog/sheet primitives (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
Create shared UI controls used across editors (segmented tabs, sliders, toggles). Use shadcn-ui slider/tabs where appropriate (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

requirements.summary: Offline-first local data layer for projects, imported media metadata, and downloaded template caches with graceful offline handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Projects list persists across refreshes and is available offline.
Template downloads are cached locally; subsequent opens do not require network access.
The app gracefully handles offline mode (no crashes; user sees offline indicators where relevant).

file_operations.description: Implement an IndexedDB helper (open DB, read/write/delete, versioning) for projects, template payload caches, and media metadata (lightweight, offline-first).
Define frontend-only types for locally stored project metadata/editor state, media metadata, and cached template payloads (no backend schema details).
Create a projects storage module providing list/search/sort/put/delete/duplicate operations backed by IndexedDB; optimized for instant load on repeat visits.
Create a template download/cache module that stores template payloads and metadata locally; supports cache lookup by id/version and offline availability.
Add a small hook that tracks navigator.onLine plus online/offline events and exposes an offline flag for UI indicators.

Add an unobtrusive offline indicator banner/toast shown when offline and used on key screens (Home/Templates/Projects/Editors). Use shadcn-ui toast/alert patterns if available (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
Wire offline status provider/UI: show offline indicator where relevant and ensure screens use local storage modules for initial render even without network.

requirements.summary: Templates section with the specified preloaded Video/Photo templates, editable in editors, downloadable and cached for offline use.
acceptanceCriteria: Templates screen shows the listed template items grouped by Video/Photo.
User can open a template into an editor with editable layers/fields (e.g., text fields, placeholder media) and save as a new project.
Downloading a template once makes it available offline on subsequent app loads.
Backend provides a canonical template catalog endpoint (or config) that the frontend consumes.

file_operations.description: Define the required preloaded template catalog entries (Video: TikTok intro, YouTube intro, Slideshow, Birthday video, Business promo; Photo: Instagram post, YouTube thumbnail, Poster, Resume cover, Flyer) with minimal editable fields and default layer definitions.

Implement a frontend templates data loader that merges preloaded catalog with backend-provided template metadata (via existing actor template methods) when available, while remaining usable offline from cache.
Create React Query hooks for listing templates, reading a single template, and tracking downloaded/offline availability; prefer cached/local data when offline.

Render the grouped Video/Photo template grid/list, show empty state when none, show download/cached state, and wire navigation into the appropriate editor with the template instantiated. Use shadcn-ui card/badge components for consistent styling (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
Add a mobile sheet/modal for template preview, description, entitlement badge, and actions: Download for offline / Use template.
Implement logic to instantiate a template into a new editable project (video or photo), assign a new local project id, and persist initial editor state to IndexedDB.
Add route wiring for opening a template into the Video Editor or Photo Editor (e.g., an editor route that accepts a local project id created from a template).

requirements.summary: Offline-capable video editor with timeline UI, multi-layer composition, core editing tools, touch pinch-to-zoom, and export at 720p/1080p without watermark.
acceptanceCriteria: Timeline UI supports multiple tracks/layers and a playhead.
User can add/edit at least: a text layer and a sticker layer; trim/split a clip; adjust speed; apply at least one filter/color adjustment.
Pinch-to-zoom (or equivalent) works on the timeline on touch devices.
Export flow allows selecting 720p/1080p and produces a downloadable file without watermark branding.

file_operations.description: Create the main Video Editor screen: preview area, tool drawer, timeline section, play controls, and save-to-project behavior; ensure it works offline using local project state.
Define the video project editor state model (tracks/layers, clip ranges, speed, basic effects) and serialization to/from local storage.
Implement a timeline with multi-track lanes, a draggable playhead, and basic clip rendering. Use consistent motion/transition rules from the design system.
Implement touch-friendly pinch-to-zoom (or equivalent) for the timeline scale using Pointer Events; update timeline zoom state smoothly on mobile.

Provide a tool to add/edit a text layer (content, font size, timing) and persist changes to the project state. Use shadcn-ui inputs/selects where appropriate (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
Provide a tool to add a sticker layer (from a small built-in sticker set) and position/scale it over time; persist to project state.
Implement trim and split operations for a selected clip (state-only operations), updating clip segments on the timeline.
Implement speed control for a selected clip (state + preview playback rate), persisted to the project state.
Implement at least one filter/color adjustment (e.g., brightness/contrast or a LUT-like preset) applied in preview rendering and persisted to project state.
Implement a basic transitions selector for clip boundaries (at least one transition type) and store the chosen transition in state (rendered as a simple crossfade in preview where feasible).
Provide a small built-in music library selector (local bundled audio assets or user-selected file metadata) to attach an audio layer; ensure offline availability for built-in items.
Implement a lightweight preview renderer that composes layers (video/text/stickers) with basic effects for on-device preview without requiring network access.

Implement export UX: choose 720p/1080p, show progress, then trigger a browser download; ensure no watermark branding is added. Use shadcn-ui dialog/progress components (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

Implement a browser-based export pipeline (e.g., canvas composition + MediaRecorder where supported) that produces a downloadable file at selected resolution; include fallbacks/guardrails for unsupported devices.
Wire navigation/routes to open VideoEditorScreen for creating new video projects and opening existing video projects from Projects/Templates.

requirements.summary: Offline-capable photo editor with crop/resize, filters/presets, brightness/contrast/saturation, text/stickers, background blur/removal, and export JPG/PNG.
acceptanceCriteria: User can import/select an image into the photo editor and apply crop/resize and at least one filter.
Brightness/contrast/saturation controls update the preview and persist to the saved project.
Export produces JPG or PNG as selected.
Background blur is available; background removal is exposed as a tool (may be a basic/approximate implementation).

file_operations.description: Create the main Photo Editor screen: image preview canvas, tool controls, and save-to-project behavior; works fully offline with local project state.
Define photo project editor state (source image reference, crop/transform, adjustments, overlays) and serialization to/from local storage.
Implement crop/resize UI and apply to preview; persist crop parameters to state. Use shadcn-ui sliders/inputs as needed (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
Provide at least one preset filter (e.g., warm/mono) applied via canvas/CSS filter pipeline and persisted to state.
Implement brightness/contrast/saturation sliders that update preview live and persist values to state.
Provide tools to add/edit text overlays and sticker overlays (position/scale/rotation) and persist to state.
Implement background blur (e.g., approximate blur with masked subject region optional, or global blur with foreground overlay) and persist settings to state.
Expose a basic/approximate background removal action (e.g., simple segmentation heuristic or edge-based matting) with clear labeling; persist resulting mask/setting to state.
Implement export UX to choose JPG/PNG and trigger download. Use shadcn-ui dialog/progress components (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
Implement canvas-based export to JPG/PNG based on chosen format and current editor state.
Wire navigation/routes to open PhotoEditorScreen for creating new photo projects and opening existing photo/template-derived photo projects.

requirements.summary: Dynamic update system driven by remotely configurable JSON: feature toggles, tool enable/disable, template add/remove; startup version check, background refresh, major-update prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an endpoint/method returning the remote config JSON (versioned).
Frontend fetches config on startup, caches it locally, and uses it to show/hide tools and templates without redeploying the frontend bundle.
Frontend performs a silent background refresh and updates cached config when minor changes occur.
When config major version changes, the UI displays a clear “New update available” prompt with a refresh action.

file_operations.description: Define the remote-config JSON shape used by the frontend (version fields, feature toggles, tool flags, template overrides, monetization toggle), kept decoupled from backend implementation details.

Implement config fetching with caching to IndexedDB/localStorage, including: load-from-cache-first, network refresh when online, and tolerant parsing/validation. Where available, call a backend capability via the actor; otherwise support a fallback to a hosted JSON asset.
Create React Query hooks for remote config: initial load at startup, silent background refresh, and derived selectors for feature/tool/template availability.

Implement a UI prompt shown when a major config version change is detected; includes a clear refresh action. Use shadcn-ui alert/dialog primitives (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
Wire remote config bootstrap on app launch, apply toggles to navigation/tools/templates, and mount the major-update prompt when needed.
Apply remote-config template add/remove and template visibility rules; ensure cached templates remain usable offline while honoring toggles.
Apply remote-config tool enable/disable toggles (e.g., transitions, advanced grading) so the editor UI updates without redeploy.
Apply remote-config tool enable/disable toggles for photo editor tools so the UI updates without redeploy.

requirements.summary: Projects management: local offline list, search/sort, duplicate, delete, and open projects into the correct editor.
acceptanceCriteria: Projects tab lists saved projects and supports opening them into the appropriate editor.
User can delete a project and it is removed from local storage.
Project list loads without network access.

file_operations.description: Create hooks for loading/searching/sorting projects from the offline projects store with instant cached render; expose actions (open, duplicate, delete).

Create a mobile-friendly projects list/grid with search input, sort selector, and action menu per project (open/duplicate/delete). Use shadcn-ui input/dropdown/menu components (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
Wire the projects hooks and list UI into the Projects tab; show empty state illustration when no projects; ensure open routes into the correct editor type.
Implement duplicate/delete behaviors (offline-only) and ensure editor state is removed/duplicated atomically in local storage.
Ensure project-open navigation is fully wired from Projects into VideoEditorScreen/PhotoEditorScreen using stored project type metadata.

requirements.summary: Feature gating system for optional Free vs Pro entitlements with clear UI indicators and ability to disable monetization entirely via config.
acceptanceCriteria: There is a single source of truth for entitlements (Free/Pro) consumed by the UI to enable/disable gated features.
Premium templates and advanced tools are visibly marked and cannot be used on Free (with an explanatory prompt).
A configuration toggle (remote config or build flag) can disable monetization/Pro entirely and remove gating UI.

file_operations.description: Implement a single source of truth for entitlements: derive current entitlement from user profile (when authenticated) and remote-config monetization toggle; expose helpers like canUse(feature) and isProEnabled.
Create hooks that combine remote config + user profile data into UI-ready gating flags; include a safe offline default (Free) unless cached user profile indicates Pro.
Add a small consistent Pro badge/lock indicator for premium templates/tools. Use shadcn-ui badge components if available (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

Create an explanatory prompt/sheet shown when a gated action is attempted on Free; must keep app functional and allow dismissal. Use shadcn-ui dialog/sheet primitives (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)
Mark premium templates, prevent use when on Free (show UpsellPrompt), and hide all gating UI entirely when monetization is disabled by remote config.
Gate advanced transitions/advanced color grading controls behind Pro; keep basic tools available on Free; hide gating UI when monetization is disabled by remote config.
Include monetization enable/disable toggle and gated feature flags in the remote-config type so the UI can fully remove gating when disabled.

Implement a small wrapper that loads the caller profile (when authenticated) and exposes it to the entitlement system; ensure profile is cached and cleared on logout. Use the authorization component’s frontend guidance (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

requirements.summary: Add repo documentation describing frontend architecture: folder structure, state management, offline storage, editor approach, and dynamic update flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Repo contains a readable architecture document explaining major modules and data flows.
Document includes how templates are defined, downloaded, cached, and instantiated into editable projects.
Document describes how remote config is fetched, cached, and applied (including major update prompt).

file_operations.description: Write the frontend architecture document covering: folder/modules, React Query usage, IndexedDB offline strategy, project/template caching model, editor engines (video/photo) approach, and the dynamic update flow (startup load, version check, background refresh, major-update prompt).

requirements.summary: Include generated static brand/UI assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI (e.g., app header/landing, empty states).
Assets are loaded directly by the frontend (not via backend calls).

file_operations.description: Add the generated app icon asset at the required path and filename.
Add the generated splash/hero illustration asset at the required path and filename.
Add the generated Projects empty-state illustration asset at the required path and filename.
Add the generated Templates empty-state illustration asset at the required path and filename.
Reference frontend/public/assets/generated/clipforge-splash.dim_1242x2688.png in the Home UI (e.g., hero/header area) as a static asset.
Reference frontend/public/assets/generated/clipforge-empty-projects.dim_1200x800.png in the Projects empty state UI as a static asset.
Reference frontend/public/assets/generated/clipforge-empty-templates.dim_1200x800.png in the Templates empty state UI as a static asset.
Wire the app icon by referencing frontend/public/assets/generated/clipforge-app-icon.dim_1024x1024.png in the document head (favicon / app icon metadata as appropriate for the existing setup).
